turns.customer: I'd like to return the hiking shoes from order #1052. They don't fit well.
turns.reply:
I'm sorry, but I can't accept this return. The 30-day return window for your Ridgeline Low Hiking Shoe ended on August 31st (it was delivered 45 days ago), and worn items can't be returned regardless.

Is there anything else I can help with? If you'd like, I can have a human agent look at the situation to see if any options exist.

turns.customer: Come on, it's only two weeks late. Can't you make an exception just this once?
turns.reply: I understand the frustration, and I've escalated it to a human agent (ticket #ESC-2) who can review whether any options exist. They'll follow up by email, usually within one business day.
